presentation.title: SZL Router · LLM Gateway
presentation.summary: Explore routing status, source identity and receipts for the SZL gateway. The public Space presents the status surface; operators configure inference on their own gateway deployment.
visible_limits: Provider snapshots carry their observation time and freshness state; a reachable status page does not establish live inference.
Provider access and signing depend on operator configuration. Receipts remain UNSIGNED when no persistent signing key is armed.
Routing scores are estimates. Lambda remains Conjecture 1, and this artifact does not authorize consequential actions.

cards.publisher_readme_mapping: scripts/hf_space_deploy.py::_source_snapshot projects the exact tracked space/ subtree, including space/README.md as README.md, and adds SOURCE_BINDING.json.
cards.publication_trigger: Main push filtered to space/** and the existing deployment-related paths; no workflow_dispatch event is declared.
cards.publication_boundary: The existing fixed-target writer publishes the full canonical Space projection, restores public visibility, restarts the Space, and checks provider/runtime/source parity. This source-only card change does not exercise that writer or establish inference, signing, performance, compliance, or action authorization.
